freshness_method: All selected IDs are absent from the deliberate new_lexical_targets used in canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 Unit 1. The guarded promotion must independently recheck freshness against all prior canonical Urdu records before append.

targets.sense_note: Use the modern work/employment sense, not older attendance/service branches.
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta entries and compounds such as ملازمت کرنا / ملازمت پیشہ support employment/service use.

targets.intended_sense: profession, occupation, or line of work
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines پیشہ as occupation/business and work used as a means of livelihood.

targets.intended_sense: initiative; taking the first constructive step without waiting to be told
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta supports beginning/commencement and the expression پہل کرنا for taking the initiative.

targets.intended_sense: mutual or reciprocal, involving both sides
conflict or disagreement between people or sides
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines تنازع as باہمی نزاع، جھگڑا، اختلاف.

targets.intended_sense: respect; treating another person or their position with regard and dignity
advice or a considered suggestion offered to help a decision
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta related entries define مشورت/مشورہ as صلاح, advice, and exchange of views.

targets.intended_sense: brief or concise, without unnecessary length
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines مختصر as something without lengthiness, کم/تھوڑا, and gives مختصر گفتگو.
Rekhta gives available/procurable/attained and Urdu مہیا/حاصل.

targets.intended_sense: salary or regular pay received for work
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines it as money generally paid monthly in return for employment/service; English salary, wages, pay.
Rekhta defines عارضی as غیر مستقل، چند روزہ، وقتی.

targets.intended_sense: agreement or contract setting commitments between parties
targets.sense_note: The teaching passage uses a fictional work agreement and does not make jurisdiction-specific legal claims.
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines معاہدہ as an agreement/compact/contract between parties setting what each agrees to do or not do.

targets.intended_sense: employee; a person who works for pay in an organization or office
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines ملازم in the paid-work sense and compounds connect it directly with salary/employment.
Rekhta gives ترتیب دیا ہوا/مربوط and منظم طریقۂ کار as a coherent orderly process.

targets.intended_sense: completion or finishing of a task/process
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines تکمیل as کامل کرنا، پورا کرنا and English completion/finishing.

generation_guardrails: Use constructed workplace situations; do not imply employment-law rules from fictional contracts or policies.
P1-P5 introduce exactly three new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none.
All six passages retain the B1 10-question/10-answer contract and a 220-320 whitespace-token passage band.
Learner-facing titles, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
freshness_scope: Exact target IDs checked against all canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 Unit 1 new_lexical_targets immediately before Unit 2 append.
